# Geetanjali Softwares

> Technology & Growth Partner engineering digital futures with custom websites, high-performance web applications, SEO, and growth-oriented digital marketing.

## Core Offerings

### 1. Custom Website Design & Development
We design and develop fast, secure, mobile-responsive business websites and landing pages optimized for maximum lead conversion.
- Custom Business Websites
- Professional Website Redesign
- E-commerce Development (Custom & Shopify)
- WordPress Development & Custom CMS setups
- Single/Multi-page Landing Pages for Campaigns

### 2. Search Engine Optimization (SEO) & Search Growth
We deploy advanced organic search strategies to help brands rank higher on Google, capture high-intent search traffic, and drive leads.
- On-page & Technical SEO optimization
- Keyword Research & Strategy
- Content Marketing & Topical Authority building
- Local SEO & Google Business Profile optimization (focusing on Faridabad, Delhi-NCR, Noida, Gurgaon, and Delhi)

### 3. Custom Web Applications
For requirements that go beyond static pages, we build high-performance web tools, dashboards, and custom backend APIs.
- Next.js and Supabase Web Apps
- API Integration & Automation
- Custom database schemas & user systems

### 4. Digital Marketing & Paid Acquisition
We plan and execute marketing campaigns across multiple paid search channels, optimizing for cost-per-lead (CPL) and return on ad spend (ROAS).
- Google Ads PPC Management
- Social Media Marketing (Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, X)

## Primary Navigation & Sitemap Paths

All paths are relative to the base domain: `https://www.geetanjalisoftwares.in`

- **Homepage**: `/` (Start projects, CTA form, core introduction)
- **About**: `/about` (Company details, mission, and focus)
- **Services**: `/services` (Detailed listing of development and marketing services)
- **Portfolio**: `/portfolio` (Case studies and previous project showcases)
- **Pricing**: `/pricing` (Transparent cost structures for projects and plans)
- **Tools**: `/tools` (Free utility tools built for clients and visitors)
- **Blogs**: `/blogs` (SEO and growth guides, industry news, tech articles)
- **Contact**: `/contact` (Get in touch, location details, query forms)
- **Careers**: `/careers` (Join the engineering and marketing team)
- **Studio**: `https://studio.geetanjalisoftwares.in` (Our digital builder environment)
